reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend (used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template) with a holidays argument and adds shared daily-skip helpers instead of per-caller logic.

duplication.why: Holiday move and daily-skip rules are each defined once in shared/schedules.ts; callers only repeat the filter call and the holidays argument (and getNextDate repeats its filter/slice for the reverse lookup).

placement.why: Date rules live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helper; server callers and parseRecurDate only thread the new field through.

scope.why: Touches only the weekend/holiday paths, the RecurConfig type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Generalising the move into a step loop over isWeekendOrHoliday is clean; the over-fetch by holidays.length and the need for every caller to remember both the filter and the holidays argument are mild burdens.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend-handling callers go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isSkippedDailyOccurrence.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts: holidays-as-weekend moving in getDateWithSkippedWeekend/isWeekendOrHoliday and daily holiday skipping in isSkippedDailyOccurrence, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts.
